name: Think Portal — Send Portal On Request (activate after hosting)

parameters.content:
## Send Portal On Request — INACTIVE until hosting is live
Staff email ai@think-technologies.com with subject:
  send portal <company name>
→ matches the client (only for @think-technologies.com
senders), emails the client their portal link + sign-in
instructions from ai@, and confirms back to the staff sender.
No match / no login email → replies to staff with the reason,
nothing goes to any client.

Portal is hosted at portal.think-technologies.com (Netlify,
custom domain via Squarespace DNS). URL updated 2026-09-06.

parameters.subject: =Your {{ $json.client_name }} client portal from Think Technologies
parameters.message:
=Hi,

Your Think Technologies client portal is ready:
https://portal.think-technologies.com/index.html?client={{ $json.slug }}

Sign in with this email address ({{ $json.clientEmail }}) using Google, or create a password the first time you sign in.

Inside you'll find your meeting notes, proposals and files, action items, and a place to leave feedback — updated as we work together.

— Think Technologies

parameters.subject: =Portal sent to {{ $('Combine').first().json.client_name }}
parameters.message: =Done — the portal link was emailed to {{ $('Combine').first().json.clientEmail }} for {{ $('Combine').first().json.client_name }}.

parameters.subject: =Couldn't send portal — {{ $json.reason }}
